attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"If elected again, Trump will appoint more justices in the same ideological mold as past appointees.", "claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trump's past Supreme Court short lists have always been stocked with far-right ideologues.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trump made clear in his first term that his goal was to appoint as many far-right judges as he could, regardless of their qualifications.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The American Bar Association deemed a series of candidates appointed by Trump to lifetime seats as “not qualified”.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Three-quarters of Trump's judicial appointees were men.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"84 percent of Trump's judicial appointees were white.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If Trump continues appointing extreme conservatives to the Court, the far right will have final say over laws for decades.", "claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The consequences for the country will be devastating if Trump continues appointing extreme conservatives to the Court.", "claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden will continue to appoint justices and judges across the federal bench who are committed to defending American rights and freedoms, like Justice Jackson.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Justice Jackson is a brilliant jurist.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
